text:
rachel: Heads-up — after today's rbac rollout `rbac-unify-2026` a small subset of viewer/editor roles on org-scoped resources lost the inherited flag. Users in those orgs see inconsistent Console buttons (e.g., Create Dataset grayed, but API shows org-level perms).

tom: Which deploy and which orgs?

rachel: Deploy: rbac-unify-2026 (deploy-bot). Affected examples: org-203 and org-274. Repro: project p_ds_42 returns empty project perms but org returns expected role.

priya: Can you paste the permission API responses?

rachel: Project: `{ "user": "u_303", "role": null, "permissions": [] }`
Org: `{ "user": "u_303", "role": "viewer", "permissions": ["dataset:view"] }`

audit-bot: rbac.migration run id=mig-20260510-02 by svc account rbac-migrator@infra at 2026-05-10T09:02Z. Note: 2 nodes reported lock timeouts.

sec-oncall: Impact P2 (UX/regression). Security risk low (no elevation) but confusing for customers. Need an incident and a plan.

tom: Forensics quick win: UI currently prefers project-level perms when present. If project perms empty we should fallback to org-level. I'll push fallback behind flag `ui.rbac.org-fallback` to reduce customer friction while we fix DB.

ux: Please surface a tooltip if fallback is used: "Using org-level permission — contact admin to configure project access."

priya: Root cause likely migration backfill skipped rows when lock timeout happened. Query: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rbac_roles WHERE inherit_org=false AND resource_type='project' AND org_id IN ('org-203','org-274');` -> returns 14 rows.

rachel: Requeued migration with run_id=mig-20260510-02-retry. infra-bot queued it with retry/backoff.

audit-bot: Added audit entry INC-20260510-9 and attached migration runids and lock timeout logs.

priya: Plan: 1) re-run backfill with advisory lock retry, 2) once complete, verify zero inconsistent rows, 3) remove UI fallback flag. Also add preflight that checks replication/lock health before migration.

sec-oncall: Also add an alert if `inherit_org=false` row-count > 0 for >5m after migration run.

tom: Pushed small frontend patch to check org endpoint if project perms empty; flag enabled for affected orgs. Will add the tooltip.

ux: UX updated — tooltip text added.

rachel: Migration retry started at 2026-05-10T09:11Z. Logs -> https://logs.redwood.ai/mig-20260510-02-retry

priya: Post-run check: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rbac_roles WHERE inherit_org=false AND resource_type='project' AND org_id IN ('org-203','org-274');` -> 0. Backfill successful.

audit-bot: migration run mig-20260510-02-retry completed at 2026-05-10T09:18Z. Audit entry updated.

sec-oncall: Confirm removal of the UI fallback within 1 hour and monitor metrics for soft-fallback telemetry `rbac.ui.fallback_used`.

tom: Fallback flag removed for orgs and global toggle will be off once metrics stable. Telemetry showed 3 fallbacks in the 7m window.

priya: Follow-ups added to ticket: add advisory-lock retry in migration tooling, add preflight to detect replica lock contention, and add integration test covering org/project inherit behavior.

rachel: Thanks team. I'll file a short postmortem note on INC-20260510-9 and attach run ids + queries we used to validate. :white_check_mark:
